# PixelGarage — Software Studio

> PixelGarage is a software studio based in India that designs, builds, and launches iOS & Android mobile applications, custom web applications, and backend API systems from scratch to production. Founded by Saran Adhith, Daraneesh, and Alwin Joseph.

## Entity Disambiguation
- **Official Name:** PixelGarage
- **Type:** Software Development Studio / Professional Technology Services
- **Website:** https://pixelgarage.in
- **Contact Email:** pixelgarage.info@gmail.com
- **Country:** India
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Founder:** Saran Adhith
- **Co-Founders:** Daraneesh (CTO), Alwin Joseph (Lead Dev)
- **Team Size:** 8 core engineers + 25+ QA testers per release

## Studio Mission
PixelGarage takes software products from first idea to a live, production-ready product — handling design, mobile development, web development, and backend engineering under one accountable team with zero handoffs.

## Key Differentiators
- One team handles the entire product lifecycle: design → mobile → web → backend → launch
- Every release is tested by 25+ QA testers before production deployment
- Clients receive 100% ownership of source code, backend infrastructure, and deployment accounts at launch
- Custom-built from scratch — no templates, no off-the-shelf solutions
- Upfront fixed-cost quotes with clear payment milestones and zero hidden fees
- Founder-led: the people who scope your project are the same ones who build and launch it

## Core Services
1. **iOS & Android Mobile App Development:** Custom native (SwiftUI, Kotlin Jetpack Compose) and cross-platform (React Native) apps engineered from scratch. App Store and Google Play Store submission included.
2. **Custom Web Development:** High-performance web applications built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern styling frameworks.
3. **Backend Engineering & APIs:** Scalable Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, GraphQL, and RESTful backends built for security and high delivery velocity.
4. **AI & GTM Automation Workflows:** Self-hosted n8n automation pipelines integrated with Claude, OpenRouter LLMs, HubSpot CRM, Slack, and Google Sheets.

## Shipped Products & Portfolio
- **Mount Valley School Platform:** Custom front-end web application and secure backend platform built and operating live in production for Mount Valley School.
- **RoomAdda Booking App:** Mobile stay and room booking app for iOS and Android, with listing, search, and reservation backend engines, tested release after release.
- **CommunityTracker.ai GTM Automation Stack:** 100+ AI automation workflows running on a self-hosted Hostinger VPS, powering content generation, competitor intelligence, and outreach for CommunityTracker.ai.

## Revenue & Impact
- Revenue delivered for clients: ₹4.5 Lakh+
- Products currently live in production: 2
- QA testers per release: 25+

## Technology Stack
- **Mobile:** Swift, SwiftUI, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, React Native
- **Web:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, GraphQL, REST APIs, Firebase
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
- **Cloud & Infrastructure:** AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Hostinger VPS, n8n (self-hosted)
- **Payments & Services:** Stripe, Firebase Auth, Push Notifications
- **Quality & Security:** Manual QA, Appium, Pen-testing, OWASP standards, Burp Suite
- **Analytics & Monitoring:** Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sentry, Mixpanel
- **Design Tools:** Figma, Git, GitHub, Postman

## Project Delivery Process ("Flight Plan")
- **Phase T-04 — Discover:** Scoping session, mapping goals and user constraints, defining milestones and transparent fixed-cost pricing upfront.
- **Phase T-03 — Design:** Designing user flows and interactive screens in Figma before code execution, so clients see the product before it is built.
- **Phase T-02 — Build:** Iterative engineering of app, web, and backend. Every release is checked by 25+ testers before moving to production. Regular working previews and a direct line to the builders.
- **Phase T-00 — Launch:** App Store and Play Store submissions, cloud deployment, full source code handover, and ongoing post-launch support for bugs, updates, and iterations.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: What kinds of projects does PixelGarage take on?**
  A: PixelGarage takes on iOS & Android app development, custom website development, backend and API engineering, and AI/GTM automation projects. They can build a single component or an entire end-to-end product.

- **Q: Does PixelGarage build from scratch or use templates?**
  A: Everything is designed and engineered from scratch to fit the client's brand and requirements. PixelGarage never uses generic off-the-shelf templates.

- **Q: Who owns the code after PixelGarage builds the product?**
  A: The client owns 100% of the source code, backend infrastructure, and deployment accounts at launch. Full handover is included in every project.

- **Q: How long does a PixelGarage project take?**
  A: Typically 4 to 12 weeks depending on product scope. After the discovery phase, PixelGarage provides a clear roadmap with defined milestones.

- **Q: How much does PixelGarage charge for a project?**
  A: Pricing depends on scope and complexity. PixelGarage provides upfront fixed-cost quotes with no hidden fees and clear payment milestones before work begins.

- **Q: Does PixelGarage provide post-launch support?**
  A: Yes. PixelGarage stays on post-launch for bug fixes, performance updates, feature iterations, and security maintenance.

- **Q: Can PixelGarage work with an existing team or codebase?**
  A: Yes. PixelGarage can integrate with an existing engineering team, take over an existing codebase, or build a product end-to-end independently.

- **Q: How do I contact PixelGarage to start a project?**
  A: Contact PixelGarage via email at pixelgarage.info@gmail.com or submit the project brief form at https://pixelgarage.in/#contact. They usually respond within 24 hours.
